additional_concerns: The supplied representation is a Boolean decision layer over judgment-dependent inputs. It does not establish instrument classification, exposure measurement, the LAF category or designation applicability. OMITS findings concerning those inputs should not automatically be treated as defects in the threshold-or-designation formula.

The inclusive 50% threshold and circular-wide LAF exclusion are supported. No supplied text supports adding an exemption for existing authorisation, conditioning automatic classification on disclosure failures, or allowing document-update timing to postpone classification.

The discretionary factors are non-exhaustive. Home-regulator restrictions, risky instruments or portfolio characteristics must not become automatic positive triggers, and their absence must not become permission to disregard an actual SFC designation.

Footnote 7 expressly locates the holistic assessment below 50%. The unguarded OR does not change the classification result at or above 50%, where the threshold independently applies. Whether a particular designation remains effective after exposure changes is not established by the packet.

Missing or unsearched designation evidence cannot establish that no designation applies. Likewise, incomplete holdings or unresolved measurement cannot establish exposure below 50%. The representation expressly preserves those uncertainties.

The representation's global CONFLICT block can prevent a result even when the other branch independently establishes classification. This is an operational evidence-handling policy, not a restriction supplied by the circular; a blocked evaluation must not be interpreted as permission to avoid otherwise established complex-product treatment.

Footnote 1 states a separate 15% direct-investment limit under UT Code 7.3. It neither replaces the 50% aggregate classification threshold nor permits ignoring indirect exposure. UT Code 7.3 is absent; its full operation cannot be assessed, and the supplied unbound IDs cannot reliably be mapped to it.

The LAF exclusion is express, but the referenced circular on LAFs is absent. It would be needed to examine that separate regime or resolve category questions requiring it. No identifiable supplied dependency mapping supports assigning an ID to this missing authority.

The packet supplies no commencement rule, classification transition period or designation persistence rule. If applicability at the assessment time is disputed, obtain the circular's issuance and effective-date material and any relevant subsequent instrument; do not infer a grace period from 'as soon as practicable'.

The footnote 8 sale authorities are absent and explicitly recorded as missing. The incorporated Internal Product Approval Process circular and Advertising Guidelines are also absent if the separate distributor-selection or advertising duties are to be assessed in detail. None should be assigned one of the anonymous dependency IDs without an established mapping.

The three supplied dependency records all have null source_hash values and no identifying metadata. None qualifies as AVAILABLE, and none can be matched to a named missing authority from this packet alone.

No fund-specific holdings, NAV, assessment time or designation decision is supplied. These proposals assess source fidelity and correspondence; they do not establish a classification outcome for a particular fund or overall compliance.
